intents.text:
The agent on this site, which you are speaking with now, is a **Python LangGraph agent**. It operates using a multi-step pipeline:

* **Routing:** Simple queries are answered instantly without an LLM to save resources.
* **Retrieval:** It uses **hybrid search** (FAISS for semantic meaning and BM25 for keywords), merged via Reciprocal Rank Fusion.
* **Scoping & Safety:** It includes a gate to ensure questions remain focused on Rishabh's work and a check on every sentence before it reaches you.
* **Evaluation:** The system is tested using Python suites and RAGAS to ensure accuracy and faithfulness.

You can read more about the technical details on his [blog](/blog/how-my-portfolio-agent-works).

Yes — **Forward Deployed Engineering** is explicitly listed among his core strengths, and his recent work matches the profile:

- **Collaterals Agent** (Simplilearn): designed and shipped an N8N-based multi-agent system that cut a 7–10 day, two-team collateral process to **1 day**; won the **Best Team Award (Q3)**.  
- **TurboTrade** (Simplilearn): built a chat copilot that researches, plans and trades Indian markets using **LangChain, Groq, MCP** and a Streamlit UI — end-to-end from prototype to a usable internal tool.  
- **Scalable Sales Training Chatbot** (Simplilearn): architected a high-throughput enablement bot with **FAISS + Gemini + Google ADK**, built a **Streamlit training UI**, engineered for horizontal scale.  
- **Osteoarthritis Classification Pipeline** (OsteosConnect): led clinicians and engineers to a **96 % accurate** X-ray grading pipeline on **AWS (S3, Lambda, EC2, EMR)** with **>90 % concordance** vs. radiologists in clinical trials; beat competitor RBKnee.  
- **Gemma 3n on-device research**: ran an Android-compatible model inside a custom offline chatbot app — hands-on with edge deployment constraints.  
- **Agentic orchestration & MCP**: daily work designing how multiple agents, tools and human reviewers collaborate; open-source contributions; guardrails, evaluation and token-optimization built into every prototype.

He also brings **AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, S3, EC2), Azure AI Foundry, vLLM/Ollama/llama.cpp, LoRA/QLoRA fine-tuning, LangGraph, CrewAI, FastAPI** — the full stack a Forward Deployed Engineer needs to take a customer from problem to production.
